title: How Elevators Evolved 🛗 From Rope Hoists to 70 km/h #shorts #engineering
description:
Before elevators, a building was only as tall as people were willing to climb. From Roman lifts in the Colosseum to Elisha Otis cutting his own rope in 1854, the first passenger and electric elevators, and today's lifts that climb over 70 km/h. Follow for more How It Evolved!
